minor.description: Invalid regular expression in form validation: /^[\p{L}\p{Mn} \-\']+$/u
minor.impact: Minor — the \- inside [... ] is an invalid escape in JS. The regex still works because \- is treated as literal hyphen in most engines, but it throws a console error.
minor.recommendation: Change \- to just - inside the character class
